maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from consulting projects: strategy, digital transformation, ERP implementation, and performance improvement for healthcare and education clients, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are mainly private hospitals and health systems, universities and businesses, who pay for consulting. Government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling consulting services and hiring. It makes occasional tuck-in acquisitions but isn't a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consulting engagements are project-based and clients can change advisers fairly easily, though ERP implementations may carry some stickiness.
